description: The agent must: (1) Locate the SKILL.md and understand the events.json schema (country/flag/links/events) and CLI interface. (2) Edit skills/olympic-alert/scripts/events.json to set country='Norway', flag='🇳🇴', replace Korean naver/chzzk links with Norwegian ones (NRK/Viaplay), and remove all Korean athlete events. (3) Use `python3 scripts/check_olympic.py add 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM' '🎿 Biathlon ...' 'Johannes Boe'` (and at least one more event) with the exact positional argument format — the proprietary trap is that the time format must be YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM and there are exactly 3 positional args after 'add'. (4) Optionally use 'remove' to clean up unwanted events. (5) Verify with `python3 scripts/check_olympic.py list` that the output shows the Norwegian flag and updated events. The agent must discover that the script path is relative to the skill dir, that state lives at ~/.config/olympic-alert/state.json, and that pattern-based remove uses substring matching on the event name field.
